text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Two weeks remained until the Kugel Golem
resumed its activity. During a break in her
special training, Erika had gone into town
with {0} to pick up lunch, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クーゲルゴーレムが活動を再開するまでの二週間。
特訓の合間に{0}と昼食の買い出しに
街へ出ていたエリカだったが……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Mm! ...It's nothing serious. There's just
something that's been bothering me a
little...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
別に
大したことじゃないわ。
ただ、
少しだけ気になってることがあるっていうか……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Things were so hectic back then that I ended
up coming along with you all, remember? I've
just been wondering how everyone in
Schwarzwald is doing now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
色々とバタバタしてたから、
そのままあなたたちに
ついてきちゃったじゃない？
【シュヴァルツヴァルト】のみんなは
今頃どうしてるのかな
って。

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever... right now we need to focus
on training. We cannot let Commander
Nishizumi and the others down, and there's
not much time left either~
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあでも、
今はそれより特訓よ。
西住隊長たちの足を
引っ張るわけにもいかないし、
時間もあまり残されてないんだから──

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: ... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... this isn't the time to be acting
so carefree, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたね……
そんな呑気なことを言ってる場合じゃないでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: ...The operation...

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Well, sure... if it's part of it, then I
suppose it can't be helped. Fine, I'll go
along with your idea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうね、
任務なら仕方ないわね。
いいわ、
あなたの提案に乗ってあげる。

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
It might also be a good chance to test the
results of our training... And since this was
your idea, you're coming with me once we
finish shopping, got it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
特訓の成果を試すいい機会かもしれないし……
あなたが言い出しっぺなんだから、
買い出しが終わったら付き合いなさいよ？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
After finishing their shopping, Erika and
{0} immediately headed to the elven
village.
text_block_list.orig_text:
買い出しを終えたエリカと{0}は、
さっそくエルフの里に足を運んだ。

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Kyaru-san and the others told me not to worry
about it, but... listen, okay? We're just
checking in, and if everything's fine, we're
leaving right away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルさんたちは
「気にするな」っていってくれたけど……
い
い？　
様子を見て、
何事もなかったら
すぐに帰るからね？

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
...Commander? Commander Erika, it is you!
Welcome back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……隊長？
エリカ警備隊長じゃないですか！　
おかえりなさい！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
"I'm home"... doesn't really feel right
anymore, though. Still, I'm glad to see you
all doing well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただいま……
というのも
違う気がするけど。
あなたたちが元気そうで、
とりあえずはよかったわ。

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we're managing somehow! EVERYONE! THE
COMMANDER'S BACK!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
なんとかやってます！
──みんな、
隊長が帰ってきてくれたぞぉー！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
I only stopped by to see how things were
going. Once I know you're all safe, I'll be
leaving again. Besides... I'm not your
Commander anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただ様子を見に立ち寄っただけよ。
無事が確認できたら
すぐにここを去るつもりだし、
わたしは
もうあなたたちの隊長じゃないんだから。

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
So, what's the situation? Has anything
unusual happened?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
どうなの？
特に変わりない？

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ...Ah, that came out wrong...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！
……あ、
そうじゃなくて……

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am! Allow me to report!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！
報告いたします！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I'm not your Commander anymore,
so you don't have to be so formal... Though I
guess I'm the one who taught you to act like
that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
もう隊長じゃないからそんなにかしこまらなくて
いいってば……
わたしが
教えたことだけど……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. Judging by your reaction,
something happened. Continue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあいいわ。
その様子だと何かあったみたいだし、
続けて。

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Mm... I see. So the monsters living nearby
are getting more active...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
なるほどね。
近隣に住む魔物の動きが活発化してる……
と。

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
Yes... We don't know why, but they've been
more vicious than ever... and we haven't been
able to contain them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい……
理由は分からないんですが、
いつになく獰猛になっていて……
我々も
手のほどこしようがなく……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Maybe so. ...Geez, in other words, that's
like saying it's my fault...
text_block_list.orig_text:
かもしれないわね。
……ったく、
つまりはわたしのせいかも
ってことじゃない……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Understood. It's too dangerous to leave
things like this, so I'll help with the
extermination effort.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかったわ。
このまま放置するのも危険だし、
わたしも討伐に協力するわ。

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?! Whoa...! EVERYONE! THE COMMANDER'S
TAKING THE HELMS OF THIS SITUATION!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
本当ですか！？
うおおぉ……！　
みんな、
隊長が自ら指揮を執ってくださるぞー！

text_block_list.name: エルフたち
text_block_list.text: 隊長！
text_block_list.orig_text: 隊長！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: I told you! I'm not your Commander anymore!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから！　
隊長じゃないっていってるでしょ！

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text: M-My apologies... Former-Commander!
text_block_list.orig_text:
す、
すみませんでした！　
『元』
隊長！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: ...That phrase sounds strangely familiar...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どこかで
聞いたことあるフレーズね……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, the monsters could attack even as we
speak. Start preparing for the expedition
immediately.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
こうしている間にも魔物が攻めてくるかもしれないし。
すぐに遠征の準備に取り掛かりなさい。

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
...We're entering the forest. If we're going
to encounter them, it'll be soon, so stay
alert and keep watch on your surroundings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……森を抜けるわ。
接敵するとしたらそろそろだから、
周囲の警戒を怠らないで。

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Putting that aside... why did YOU come with
me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても……
なんで
あなたまでついてきたの？

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
I asked you to tag along, but that was just
to check on the village. It's not like you
had any obligation to help with exterminating
monsters too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
付き合ってとは言ったけど、
それは里の様子を見に行くってことで、
魔物の討伐にまで
付き合う義理はないでしょうに……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: Mm... Hmph. Do as you please.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ふん。
好きにしなさい。

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "worried"?! You think I
can't handle this on my own!? Just watch me,
I don't need you tagging along...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
心配ってなによ！
わたし一人だと不安だっていうわけ！？
見てなさい、
あなたの付き添いなんて必要ないんだから……！

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text: Commander! That's...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
隊長！　
あれを……！

text_block_list.name: A group of monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 2
text_block_list.text: There they are...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: でやがった……！！

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 3
text_block_list.text: EEEEK?! WHY ARE THEY SO MANY!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひぃぃぃっ！？
なんて数だ！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
DON'T PANIC! Form up and drive them back with
a coordinated volley!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うろたえない！
陣形を組んで、
一斉掃射で蹴散らしなさい！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: FIRE!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──撃て！

text_block_list.name: A group of monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
They repelled it...!? And why are monsters
using a formation without a single
opening...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はじき返された……！？
っていうか、
魔物のくせに隙がない陣形を組んでるんだけど……！

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text: They're coming this way...! WAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちにくる……！
うわあああああっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing?! As long as the formation
holds, attacks like this are nothing...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何やってるの！
陣形さえ崩されなければ
この程度の攻撃……！

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 2
text_block_list.text: Dammit... These things...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
クソ……
こいつら……！

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 3
text_block_list.text: EEEEK! I CAN'T TAKE IT ANYMORE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひいぃぃ！　
もうダメだぁ！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
...No other choice. Temporary retreat! We'll
fall back for now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……仕方ないわ。
一
時撤退！　
ここはいったん退くわよ！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like they won't follow us this far.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
さすがにここまでは追ってこないようね。

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
Commander... We're sorry... It's because we
held you back...
text_block_list.orig_text:
隊長……
すみません……
俺たちが足を引っ張ったせいで……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
An apology won't solve anything. ...And
besides, the responsibility lies with me as
the one leading this operation. Tend to the
wounded and prepare for a counterattack.
text_block_list.orig_text:
謝罪したところで事態は解決しないわ。
……それに、
これは指揮を執ったわたしの責任でもある。
あなたたちは
怪我人の手当てと、
反撃の準備をお願い。

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
...That said. I wonder if this is also the
influence of that so-called Kugel Golem.
Those monsters were using a flawless
formation... Breaking through head-on will be
difficult. And everyone already looks
exhausted...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……とはいえ。
これもクーゲルゴーレムとやらの影響なのかしら。
魔物たちのあの完璧な陣形……
正面からの突破は難しいわね。
みんなも
だいぶ疲弊しているみたいだし……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
At a time like this... Commander Nishizumi
would...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんな時、
西住隊長だったら……

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text: Commander...
text_block_list.orig_text: 隊長……

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
We'll follow whatever orders you give us,
Commander! If we can just carry them out
properly, then I'm sure we can win...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺たちは、
隊長の指示でしたら
なんでも従います！
俺たちがちゃんと隊長の指示通りに動けたなら、
必ず勝てるはずですから……！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: All of... you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
あなたたち……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: {0}-san... What do you think? I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
あなたは
どう思う？
わたしは……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: Mm...! You too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
あなたまで……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. Gather everyone together as soon as
you've finished treating the injured. I'll
tell you about our next operation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……わかったわ。
怪我人の処置が終わり次第で、
みんなを集めて。
次の作戦を伝えるから。

text_block_list.name: Elves
text_block_list.text: YES!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: はい！！！

text_block_list.name: A group of monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: A group of monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: エリカ
text_block_list.text:
こんな戦い方、
西住隊長ならきっとしない……
でも、
ここで勝つために
わたしが考えた作戦は……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんな戦い方、
西住隊長ならきっとしない……
でも、
ここで勝つために
わたしが考えた作戦は……！

text_block_list.name: A group of monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more... stir them up just a
little more...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう少し……
もう少しだけ引っかき回して……！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: NOW!!!

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
We hit them this time...!? Thanks to the
Commander's diversion, the monsters'
formation is falling apart!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度はちゃんと当たった……！？
隊長の陽動のおかげで、
魔物たちの陣形が崩れてる！

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 2
text_block_list.text:
But... if we let things stand, the Commander
will be in danger while fighting alone on the
frontlines! KEEP THOSE ARROWS COMING!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
このままだと一人で前線で戦ってる隊長が危険だ！
もっともっと撃ちまくれー！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
I'll be fine! Now, let's seize this
opportunity and wipe them out in one go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしは大丈夫よ！
さ
ぁ、
この機を逃さず、
一気に蹴散らすわよ！

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 3
text_block_list.text:
C-Commander! The cornered monsters are trying
to escape...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
隊長！
追い詰めた魔物たちが逃げようとしてます……！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Fools...! There's no way I'd let you get away
that easily!
text_block_list.orig_text:
バカね……！
そう簡単に逃がしてあげるわけないでしょ！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: "Handstreich"!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 『ハントシュトライヒ』！！！

text_block_list.name: A group of monsters
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: ...Haah... haah... Did I get them...?

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Commander! It's our complete
victory!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やりました、
隊長！
我々の完全勝利です！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm! This... hardly even counts as a
"strategy". If Commander Nishizumi were here,
she would've crushed them head-on with
overwhelming force...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！
こ
んなの……
大した作戦じゃないわ。
西住隊長なら、
正面からもっと圧倒的に……

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What was that sound...? Could it be...
you're hungry, Commander?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
今の音って……？
もしかして
お腹がすいたんですか、
隊長？

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shut up! If you're my former subordinate,
you should be a little more considerate and
just pretend you didn't hear me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるさいわね！
わたしの元部下なら
少しは気をきかせて、
聞かなかったフリでもしておきなさい！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, how embarrassing... I feel like
stuffing myself with hamburgers right now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく、
しまらないわね……
ハンバーグでもやけ食いしたい気分よ……

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
...Hamburgers, you say? If that's what you
want, we'll treat you to as many as you like
to celebrate our victory!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ハンバーグですか？
それだったら、
勝利の祝いも込めて
いくらでもごちそうしますよ！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
You don't get it. What I want to eat are the
hamburgers from Kuromorimine. I've had
hamburgers in this village before, but they
tasted completely different.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかってないわね。
わたしが食べたいのは、
黒森峰のハンバーグよ。
ここの里でハンバーグは食べたことあるけど、
味がまったく違ったわ。

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
Kuromorimine's hamburger...? I don't really
understand what that is, but if it earned
your praise, it must be amazing, Commander!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くろもりみねの、
ハンバーグ……？
よくわかりませんけど、
隊長がそこまで絶賛するのであれば、
すごいハンバーグなんでしょうね。

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
You all, why're you copying me now...! And
what's with those eyes that are begging me to
try it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたたち、
そろいもそろって……！
なんなのよ、
そのもの欲しそうな目は！？

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
Same here! I'm also curious about the taste
of your cooking, Commander!
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺も！
隊長がそこまでいう味、
気になります！

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 2
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaaah! No good, I'm hungry from fighting,
and all I can think about now is that amazing
hamburger...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわああああ！
ダメだ、
戦って腹が減ってることもあって、
そのすごいハンバーグのことしかもう考えられねぇ……！

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 3
text_block_list.text:
Commander! Can you tell me more about the
taste of that hamburger?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
隊長ぉ～！
いったい
どんな味のハンバーグなんですか～！？

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text: You guys...!
text_block_list.orig_text: あなたたちねぇ……！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*. Fine... I get it. I don't know if
I'll be able to properly recreate it, but
I'll whip up some for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はぁ。
わかった……
わかったわよ。
再現可能かわからないけど、
作ってあげるわ。

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text: You really will?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当ですか、
隊長！？

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
You guys were so unreliable before, but you
did a great job this time. Even though I'm
only a temporary Commander, I'll give you
atleast that much of a reward.
text_block_list.orig_text:
頼りなかったあなたたちが、
今回は頑張ったからね。
臨時の指揮官だけど、
そのぐらいはねぎらってあげるわ。

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
However! You must continue your training
while I prepare the hamburgers, okay? After
all, you are all members of my guild,
"Schwarzwald".
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただし。
わたしがハンバーグを作るまでの間も、
鍛錬は続けなさいよ？
仮にもわたしのギルド、
【シュヴァルツヴァルト】の一員なんだから。

text_block_list.name: People of the Elven Village 1
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! Thank you very much,
Commander...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
それはもちろん！
ありがとうございます、
隊長……！

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... We finally achieved victory, so why
do I have to prepare hamburgers....
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
せっかくの勝利だっていうのに、
なんでハンバーグを作ることになってるんだか……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
That... what does it even mean? It's even
more irritating because it doesn't seem like
you're saying it sarcastically...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それ
どういう意味よ？
嫌味でいってるわけじゃなさそうなのが、
余計に腹立たしいわね……

text_block_list.name: Erika
text_block_list.text:
Or rather... I'll have you help me out. I
don't know anything about this world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
というか、
あなたにも手伝ってもらうわよ。
こっちの世界のこと、
わたしはなんにも知らないんだから。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Even while keeping up her prickly attitude,
Erika didn't seem entirely displeased about
it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツンケンした態度は取りながらも、
どこかまんざらでもなさそうなエリカなのだった……
